blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Parañaque City has deferred the implementation of its no-contact apprehension policy (NCAP). its local government said Tuesday. Parañaque public information officer Erel Cabatbat confirmed to the Inquirer that the policy “is not being implemented as of now.” The local government had yet to provide a reason for the deferment as of publication. Earlier, Valenzuela City also temporarily suspended the return of NCAP, citing road conditions.
